How PnL and ROE work on Gate

Gate lists thousands of tokens and offers perpetual futures across an enormous range of markets, with up to 100x leverage. Your raw profit on a Gate trade is the price move times your position size: (Exit − Entry) × Size for a long, and the reverse for a short. Price ROI is the percentage the asset moved; ROE is your return on the margin you actually posted, which Gate's leverage multiplies.

Worked example

A 0.5-coin long opened at $60,000 and closed at $66,000 at 10× leverage:

Profit+$3,000.00
Price ROI+10.00%
ROE (10×)+100.00%

Leverage cuts both ways — the same move down would be a 100% loss of margin. Plan your exit and check your Gate liquidation price first.

FAQ

How is ROE different from ROI on Gate?

Price ROI is the raw % move. ROE multiplies it by your leverage — it is your return on posted margin. Fees and funding are not included.

Does Gate show PnL automatically?

Gate shows live PnL on open positions, but this tool lets you plan and compare scenarios before you trade.
